answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. In effect, the network makes cheating the most expensive strategy available, which is the closest thing to a Sybil-resistant design that economics allows.
